subject: E-Commerce
title: Alexa: Voice Commerce Dream
description: A micro-lesson that makes Alexa: Voice Commerce Dream usable.

hook.text: Amazon sold over 500 million Alexa devices. The goal was voice-activated shopping. Almost nobody uses it.

buildup.text: Bezos imagined a future where you say 'Alexa, reorder paper towels' and it ships instantly. Frictionless.

discovery.text: People use Alexa for music, timers, and weather. Only 2% of Alexa users have ever purchased via voice.

twist.text: The Alexa division lost $10 billion. Amazon is pivoting it toward AI assistants instead of commerce.

climax.text: Voice commerce failed because people want to see products before buying. Eyes beat ears for shopping.

punchline.text: 500M devices, 2% buy by voice. People shop with eyes, not ears.

quiz.question: What percentage of Alexa users have purchased something by voice?
